icons.name: download
icons.heading: Download
icons.description: A download lands. Light: the arrow drives down into the tray and stops dead; the tray takes the knock, rebounds and settles, and a content line draws out from the middle of the tray where the arrow lands. The spent arrow fades and a fresh one drops in from above to its rest pose, and the line fades as it settles. Strong: a short wind-up, a harder drive, a bigger knock that rebounds twice, and the line snaps out.

icons.name: upload
icons.heading: Upload
icons.description: The file goes up. Light: the arrow sinks to load, then launches up out of the tray; the tray recoils under the push, rebounds and settles, and the arrow overshoots and settles 2.2 units higher, where it stays. Strong: a deeper load, a harder launch that settles in two beats, and a bigger recoil that rebounds twice. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: copy
icons.heading: Copy
icons.description: A copy is made. Light: the front sheet presses into its source, then slides out diagonally to its new place, overshoots and settles there; a check draws on inside the sheet as it leaves and fades once it has settled. Strong: a deeper press, a longer slide that settles in two beats, and the check snaps on. The source never moves. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: trash
icons.heading: Trash
icons.description: Something is thrown away. Light: the lid flips open on its right-hand hinge, a crumpled scrap drops from under the raised edge into the bin and vanishes inside, and the lid drops shut with a hit and one chatter while the whole bin dips on contact. Strong: the lid flips wider and holds longer, two scraps drop in one after the other, and the lid slams with two chatters and a deeper dip.
